en: Colorized panoramic view over a rural village surrounded by fields and vineyards. Red‑roofed houses are scattered among dense greenery, and a small white church tower with a dark dome rises on the right. In the foreground are vineyard rows with wooden stakes. At the top left in red letters appears the word "Baltavár." A small red number "8508" is printed vertically along the left edge.
